title: Cap rearward high-risk Stage2-L language targets at caution

reason.audit_finding: Human U/R/K review found valid time-aligned conflicts whose highest task-risk support was in a rear camera. The v1 QA renderer mapped every high K value to prepare_to_yield, even though abrupt yielding or braking may worsen a rear-approach conflict.
reason.architecture_boundary: Stage2-L teaches uncertainty semantics, task relevance, and a non-binding planning posture. It does not train a trajectory or issue direct brake/steering commands. Stage2-P remains responsible for motion-conditioned action learning.

change.new_rule: When the highest K support lies in CAM_BACK, CAM_BACK_LEFT, or CAM_BACK_RIGHT, a high score is rendered as caution rather than prepare_to_yield.

affected_artifacts.existing_multiframe_qa: engineering-only and must be regenerated before the 8-event pilot dataset is frozen
affected_artifacts.route196_smoke: not invalidated when its on-path peak is frontward; it remains a one-event learnability check only

claim_boundary: This correction prevents a known unsafe language-label shortcut. It does not establish optimal rear-conflict behavior, closed-loop safety, or Stage2-P readiness.
